GIA LAI ELECTRICITY

Re: Explanation of the  Income Statement 
for Quarter 4/2025 
            SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF VIETNAM 
Independence - Freedom - Happiness 
 
 
 
Gia Lai, January 28th, 2026 
 
 
 To :  - THE STATE SECURITIES COMMISSION 
- THE HO CHI MINH STOCK EXCHANGE 
 
Pursuant to the regulations on information disclosure according to Circular No. 
96/2020/TT-BTC dated November 16, 2020 , of the Ministry of Finance, Gia Lai 
Electricity Joint Stock Company (stock symbol: GEG) hereby provides the following 
explanation for the variance of over 10% in its profit after corporate income tax (CIT) in 
the Income Statement for Quarter 4/2025 compared to the same period last year: 
Unit: billion VND 
No Item Quarter 4/2025 Quarter 4/2024 Change Q4/2025-Q4/2024 
1 
Profit after CIT in 
Separate Financial 
Statement 
64.80  64.75  0.05  
2 
Profit after CIT in 
Consolidated Financial 
Statement 
96.06  12.37  83.68  
1. Profit after corporate income tax according to the Separate Income Statement for Q4 2025 
reached VND 64.8 billion, equivalent to the same period last year, of which: 
- Financial income decreased by more than VND 43 billion, primarily due to lower dividend 
income from subsidiaries, 
- Financial expenses decreased by more than VND 48 billion, mainly due to lower provisions 
for investments in subsidiaries and associates. 
2. Profit after corporate income tax according to the Consolidated Income Statement for Q4 
2025 reached VND 96.06 billion, an increase of VND 83.68 billion compared to the same 
period due to the following reasons: 
- Revenue from sales of electricity increased by more than VND 32 billion, as Tan Phu 
Dong 1 Wind Power Plant and wind turbine A7 of VPL Wind Power Plant had official 
electricity selling prices. 
-Interest expenses decreased by nearly VND 28 billion due to a reduction in outstanding 
debt compared to the same period last year

Above is the explanation of Gia Lai Electric ity Joint Stock Company on the variance in 
profit after CIT on the Income Statement for Q 4 2025 compared to the same period last 
year. 
Respectfully submitted.
